title: Blessing of the Naaru (Part 2)
flavor: Having fallen under the yoke of the Burning Legion, the Eredar has been twisted into chaotic, ferocious entities devoid of humanity. They no longer recall their homeworld, their kin, their professions, or even their own visages. All that fills their gaze now is boundless slaughter, spreading fear across world after world.

entries.name: Shadow Demon: Disseminate ($3, Demon/Draenei/Priest)
entries.detail: New chess piece. <Active Skill: Instant Activation> Applying the toxic curse of Shadow Demon's attacks: Nearby allies will receive damage of the same type as a percentage when taking damage, and nearby enemies will also receive healing as a percentage when receiving healing. Note: The spreading effect cannot be stacked on the same unit. Note: The spreading effect can benefit from Spell Prism and Soulbind. When the Eredar no longer requires his followers, he'll discard his shackles—along with their lives.

entries.name: Lion: Finger of Death(Upgraded from $1 to $4)
entries.detail: New chess piece. <Active Skill: Activates on full mana> Tear into an enemy, inflicting a substantial amount of magical damage and siphoning their current mana. Furthermore, for each stack of the Fel Power effect, it will deal additional magical damage based on a percentage of the target's maximum health. Lion's disfigured hand is also the source of his greatest power, capable of flooding victims with malefic force.

entries.name: Draenei - Blessing of the Naaru
entries.detail: Synergy Update to(2)(4) (2)Draenei: All friendly Draenei gain the effect: Every 2 seconds, steal 100 health from the nearest enemy chess piece to heal themselves. (4)Draenei: All friendly pieces gain effects: Whenever a cumulative total of more than 100 points of healing is taken it is split (cumulative healing) points of pure damage among the surrounding enemies. Note: (2) Draenei's life-steal effect deals pure damage + healing. Draenei illusions are also effective. Note: (4)Draenei's Baptism damage is no longer divided, and each enemy within the range will receive the same damage.
